title: One red costs one red, not two full sweeps
description: Measured by the paid probe (two pairs on one task): plugin wall 10x plain. Of the 54-minute gap, task gates 38% (full ~300 s sweep, three runs), base measurement 19% (a full sweep to classify one red suite), a second writer round 31% (the first diff broke a house rule the brief never carried). Design: a declared fast pre-gate the brief lists and the gate runs first; per-suite base measurement keyed by (commit, suite); re-gate runs last reds first and stops on red; selection cache by tree identity; the drive settles a gate the product already calls stale before starting a task; the brief reads the recorded spelling. Invariant across all: a partial run may fail a change but never vouches for more than it ran.
desiredOutcome: On the measured shape (one task whose first diff turns one suite red), a red no longer costs a full base sweep and a full re-gate: the writer is told the project's fast must-pass checks and the gate runs them first; the base is measured only for the suites the red named; a re-gate runs last round's reds first; the selection is computed once per tree. Re-measured by the two-pair probe on the same task and base; W1 falls and no gate vouches for more than it ran.
